name: MonarchSlider
title: Slider
summary: A slider for one number: a 6dp track, the accent range, an 18dp thumb with a 2dp accent border, a 48dp touch target and an optional label with the value.
whenToUse: For a value where the position matters more than the exact number: volume, brightness, a zoom level.
whenNotToUse: For an exact number use MonarchNumberInput. For a range with two ends use the Material 3 RangeSlider. For a rating use MonarchRatingPicker.
api: @Composable fun MonarchSlider(value: Float, onValueChange: (Float) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, enabled: Boolean = true, valueRange: ClosedFloatingPointRange<Float> = 0f..1f, steps: Int = 0, onValueChangeFinished: (() -> Unit)? = null, invalid: Boolean = false, label: String? = null, valueLabel: ((Float) -> String)? = null, interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null)

options.name: onValueChange
options.description: Called while the user drags or presses an arrow key.

options.name: steps
options.description: Steps between the ends; 0 is continuous.

options.name: onValueChangeFinished
options.description: Called when the user lifts the thumb.

options.name: invalid
options.description: Draws the range and thumb in danger.

options.name: label
options.description: The label above the slider and its TalkBack name.

options.name: valueLabel
options.description: Formats the value shown at the end of the label row and read as the state.

options.name: enabled
options.description: A disabled control is drawn at half opacity and ignores input.

states.name: value
states.description: The track up to the thumb and the thumb use the accent strong color; the rest of the track the accent subtle color.

states.name: pressed
states.description: Material narrows the thumb while it is dragged.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Material 3 disabled colors; the value does not change by touch.

appearance: MonarchTheme maps the Material 3 scheme so that the thumb and the active track use the accent strong color and the inactive track the accent subtle color. The same roles apply in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: Built on the Material 3 Slider for its drag, keyboard and TalkBack behaviour (progress range info and the setProgress action), with a Monarch thumb and track. The thumb slot is 48dp high so the slider has a 48dp touch target. Migrating: Slider(value, onValueChange, ...) becomes MonarchSlider(value, onValueChange, ...); drop colors, thumb and track.
accessibility: The slider exposes its range and value; TalkBack reads it as a percentage unless a stateDescription says the value in words.
TalkBack can set the value with its adjust gestures; with steps the value snaps to the nearest step.
With the 48dp thumb, as in every example, the slider is at least 48dp high; the default Material slider is 44dp. SliderTest checks both.
A disabled slider is read as disabled.
The value is not shown by color alone when it is also shown as text beside the track.
edgeCases: steps counts the points between the ends, not the intervals: 0..100 in tens needs 9.
A value outside valueRange is drawn at the nearest end.
In right-to-left layouts the track fills from the right.
In this Material 3 release the set-progress accessibility action of a disabled slider still calls onValueChange, so ignore changes while the slider is disabled if that matters.

examples.title: Stream and commit
examples.template:
Column {
    MonarchSlider(
        value = volume,
        onValueChange = { volume = it },
        valueRange = {{min|double}}f..{{max|double}}f,
        onValueChangeFinished = { saved = volume },
        label = {{label}},
        valueLabel = { "${it.toInt()}" },
    )
    MonarchText(text = "Saved at ${saved.toInt()}.", style = MonarchTextStyle.Caption)
}
examples.setupTemplate:
var volume by remember { mutableFloatStateOf({{value|double}}f) }
var saved by remember { mutableFloatStateOf({{value|double}}f) }
examples.setup:
var volume by remember { mutableFloatStateOf(60.0f) }
var saved by remember { mutableFloatStateOf(60.0f) }
examples.code:

        valueLabel = { "${it.toInt()}" },

    MonarchText(text = "Saved at ${saved.toInt()}.", style = MonarchTextStyle.Caption)
